text: This report recommends a multi-year agreement between a Consumer Show Client and Exhibition Place within Enercare Centre.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved two multi-year license agreements with the Consumer Show Client for Enercare Centre, as set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (September 6, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place, for a 2-year term commencing in 2022 and expiring in 2023 on the terms and conditions of the Event Agreement and such other terms and conditions satisfactory to the Chief Executive Officer and City Solicitor. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (September 6, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place remain confidential in its entirety and not be released publicly as it contains financial information that belongs to the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place and has monetary value or potential monetary value.
